id: title:VojtechBartos:welcome new workspace members with an assistant dm

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Slack workspace team_join event handling and unifies onboarding deduplication configuration, supporting the Slack App's ability to recognize and route workspace member joins.
review.reason: The change adds support for Slack's `team_join` event type, which is required for the Slack App to recognize when a workspace is joined. It also unifies the deduplication TTL configuration for channel and workspace onboarding. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for the Slack App integration.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of implementation and configuration changes, but the actual benefit and user impact are not independently verified; no production incident or adoption data is available.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context or truncation. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds Slack event type team_join to the list of recognized Slack event types.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Slack app backend to recognize and route Slack team_join events, a prerequisite for handling workspace member joins.

observations.behavior: Renames CHANNEL_ONBOARDING_DEDUPE_TTL_SECONDS to ONBOARDING_DEDUPE_TTL_SECONDS and updates its documentation to clarify it applies to both channel and workspace joins.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes a shared deduplication TTL for both channel and workspace onboarding, supporting the new team_join deduplication and the existing channel onboarding.

observations.behavior: Adds a welcome message string for new workspace members and a new route handler for team_join events.
observations.posthog_connection: P1.F1.H4: P1.F1.H4 adds the team_join route handler, P1.F1.H3 adds the welcome message. P1.F1.H4 routes team_join events to the new handler, P1.F1.H3 provides the welcome message used by the handler.
